source.title: A network meta-analysis of safety and efficacy of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors in heart failure patients

source_consistency_findings.details: Abstract says search through March 2023; Methods says databases searched through 8 April 2024. Both statements were preserved.
Results/abstract describe 16 RCTs and 80,666 participants; Discussion describes 12 randomized trials and 69,024 participants without identifying a narrower subset.
Methods labels the tool ROB-1 but cites Sterne 2019 RoB 2 and lists the five RoB 2 domains.
Main text says many comparisons were moderate/low confidence, while supplied Supplementary Tables S2-S8 display High confidence ratings throughout despite major concerns/downgrade reasons.
Printed reference [22] appears to concatenate Wiviott et al. with a Nassif et al. citation and ends incompletely; it is preserved as printed in the reference export.

schema_gaps: LiteratureAtom has no dedicated fields for network geometry, direct-versus-indirect contribution, heterogeneity statistics, or CINeMA certainty; these are retained in canonical statements/tags and SEA coverage rather than invented structured fields.
The model is oriented to primary-literature atoms; this review was encoded explicitly as secondary synthesis evidence with tags and source-anchored provenance.
extraction_limitations: Supplementary Figures S1-S18 cited by the article were not present as image-bearing artifacts in the provided source packet; they were not reconstructed.
No external verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.

README(2).md and example_atom.json named by the @ATOM macro were not available in the supplied project sources/Drive search; higher-precedence executable model, sufficiency validator, and schema were used.

batch_manifest.scope: Main article: abstract through disclosures, including Figures 1-3 and Table 1
Supplied supplementary search, CINeMA, and league/rank Tables S1-S15
PRISMA 2020 reporting checklist used for coverage verification; no checklist item was atomized as study evidence

duplicate_consistency_review.note: Main-text estimates duplicated by the supplementary league tables were not re-emitted as duplicate atoms; distinct table-only pairwise estimates were retained.
